title: DCP Subset-Sum Modular Collision-Entropy Audit: Cosine-Product Parseval Formula, Universal Boolean-Difference Surjectivity, and Exact Ensemble Collision Law

theorems.name: Exact Cosine-Squared Product Identity for Subset-Sum Collision Probability
theorems.statement: For any weight vector a = (a_1, ..., a_m) in Z_q^m, the modular subset-sum fiber distribution P_a(z) = 2^(-m) |{x in {0,1}^m : <a, x> == z mod q}| has collision probability C(a) = sum_z P_a(z)^2 = (1/q) * sum_(u=0)^(q-1) prod_(j=1)^m cos^2(pi * u * a_j / q).

theorems.name: Universal Z_q-Surjectivity of Non-Zero Boolean Differences and Exact Mean Collision Law
theorems.statement: For every modulus q >= 2 (prime or composite) and every distinct pair x != x' in {0, 1}^m, x - x' has at least one +-1 coordinate (a unit mod q), so Pr_(a ~ Z_q^m)[f_a(x) == f_a(x') mod q] = 1/q and E_(a ~ Z_q^m)[C(a)] = 1/q + (1 - 1/q) * 2^(-m).

theorems.name: Exact Single-Coordinate Cosine-Squared Character Average on Z_q
theorems.statement: For every modulus q >= 2 and frequency u in {0, ..., q-1}, (1/q) * sum_(a=0)^(q-1) cos^2(pi * u * a / q) equals 1 for u = 0 and 1/2 for all u in {1, ..., q-1}.
